notes.title: Patch 1.03.00
notes.content:
Balancing/Gameplay changes / QoL

• Aqueducts: The ability to cross aqueducts was disabled because it irritated too many players.
• Personal Slaves: Prices increased 10 times.
• Decoration (Sedan): Respect points changed from 150 to 1.
• Resource Markers: Increased by 50% on the map.
• Slave Supplier: Now also available in the Marble menu to reduce confusion. Still available in the Slave menu.

Bugs

• Pause Mode: Cannot be exited after pressing P; now fixed (Hotfix 1.02.01).
• Fourth Personal Slave: Purchase was not possible; fixed.
• Rank Consul Buildings: Previously unlocked buildings were re-locked; fixed.
• Steam Achievements: Not granted when unlocking maps for sandbox; fixed.
• Map 5: Ship traffic was no longer possible after update 1.02.00; fixed.
• Circus Building: Overlapped the street; fixed.
• Bonn City Map: Was visible to all players, now restricted to those who completed story mode.
• Bridge Monument: Sometimes rotated 90 degrees; fixed.
• Orientation Buttons: “Great Plain” and “Island” buttons were reversed; fixed.
• Large Honor Bow: Was available before story completion; now locked properly.
• Radius Bonus: Description missing for two ranks; fixed.
• Autosave: Disabled during the tutorial.
• Tutorial Wealth: Updated because new slave prices were unaffordable.
• Fire Engines: Not visible since last patch; fixed.
• Porta Nigra: Can now be built (was previously impossible to unlock).
• Pause Mode (again): Pressing P again didn’t unpause; fixed.
• Pyre Click Bug: Clicking showed nothing; fixed.
• World Map Buttons: Two buttons were reversed and pointed to the wrong settlement; fixed.

Story (and story related bugs)

• Britain Story Stuck: Fixed.
• Pause Mode During Story: Now only resets speed if not paused. If paused, stays paused.
• Fire Mission: Players got trapped and sent to Northern France; fixed.

notes.title: 1.02.01 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hotfix
Some players reported that after pressing the P key, the buildings were never completed.

Balancing/Gameplay changes / QoL

- No changes yet.
- The wells fed by the aqueduct have been given new values. Previously 9, 7, 7. Now 7, 8, 10.
- The quest to build a basilica was triggered too early. You now need to have at least 10 equits for the quest to trigger.
- Tasks given to you in career mode can now be completed before the maximum time.
- The task to build a basilica has been changed so that it is only triggered when at least 10 Euites are reached.
- Changed the name of the smoke graphic option for residential buildings. The name was inconsistent.
- At the Ingenieurhaus, it wasn’t clear that there was a scrollable list. The display has been redesigned to make it easier to see.
- Visual error: The green display bars for the residents in the top right menu were initially always at 30%. Changed to 0%.
- It is now possible to build buildings and look at the statistics during pause mode.
- The Germania map is available in the career mode.

Bugs

- When you burn down a house, the flame always remains. It doesn’t disappear after the house has burned down: fixed.
- Buildings that needed scriptorias had already indicated the need before they were fully built: fixed.
- When a deity has increased the radius of a fountain, it accidentally also increased the aqueduct fountains: fixed.
- If buildings overlapped in the radius of influence, sometimes only one building was assessed and not all that the house had in the radius: fixed.
- Incorrect bonus description for the altar. The bonus for the consul is not 100% but 1 field: changed.
- On map 10, the markers of the water sources were shifted: fixed.
- When there were no residents in the city, certain entertainment buildings displayed negative satisfaction values: fixed.
- If one end of an aqueduct was demolished, the castellum divisorium continued to supply water: fixed.
- If a house (level 1-3) was supplied with an aqueduct, it indicated that a well was nearby: fixed.
- If you built a Lupanar and had a pub with a Meretrix upgrade next to it, the house only had 50% satisfaction with Lupanar: fixed.
- When you were on the world map, the new autosave system constantly tried to save after 5 minutes: fixed.
- The northwestern lumber merchant on map 11 never appears: fixed.
- The ad for the arcades had a typo. You only get one arcade per island, not two as stated: changed.
- If you hover the mouse over a menu item and try to move the camera, nothing happens. Leaving the UI caused the camera to jump: fixed.
- If residential buildings were built outside the negative radius of the altar, they had better satisfaction than at the edge of the radius: fixed.
- Satisfaction due to main street, altar distance, and city street was partly displayed incorrectly but was calculated correctly: fixed.
- Building a racing furnace caused delivery truck pathfinding issues. Targets 2 and 3 were partially swapped: fixed.
- Some port buildings had black markers above them: removed.
- Some players reported towns disappearing after saving. A function has been implemented that might fix this, though it’s unconfirmed. Please continue submitting bug reports if save games are corrupted.
- If you were rejected for an application, you could no longer apply again: fixed.
- Tooltip box stated that houses on main roads grant double tax revenue. This is incorrect; text corrected.
- Order to build 60 forum tiles counted incorrectly and had incorrect German translation: fixed.
- Incorrect size information for the Domus M: changed.
- On the Hispania map, the reservoir wasn’t supplying any water: fixed. In old saves, the dam may need to be rebuilt.
- Porta Nigra could not be built: fixed.
- Wrong label at iron storage: changed.
- Large villa had wrong scale: old 27, new 28 width.
- Hiring an entertainment company and saving caused calendar values to reset to zero until reopened: fixed.
- Assigning an entertainment company to a month made them disappear after consulting the augurs again: fixed.

Story (and story-related bugs)

- In the mission to burn down houses, a counter now shows how many you have burned.
- Restarting or deleting certain cities was not possible. Issue resolved; deletion is still restricted in Fire Mission.
- In one mission, 1000 iron and 2000 wood were needed but only counted as successful with 1001 iron and 2001 wood: fixed.
- Burning down 10 houses did not work for some. Now fixed.
- Story dead-end fixed.
- Unlocking the largest map in story mode didn’t allow play. Now selectable after unlocking.

notes.title: Patch 1.01.00
notes.content:
Salvete Romans
Various bugs have been fixed. You can find the list of Discord reports at this link.
https://paxaugusta.ch/de/changes-fixes/

There is a known error when building a bridge monument. This will be fixed with the next patch. All other known bugs will also be addressed in the coming days.

Balancing/Gameplay Changes / QoL

New icon for full screen mode (Settings/Graphics), icon also available on the home screen.
Buttons in the settings renamed from „close“ to „save“.
Built-in autosave function. Set to 15 minutes by default. Can be adjusted in the settings menu.
Adjusted the loading behavior for a saved city. It now shows how many buildings still need to be loaded until the savegame is fully loaded. Previously, the map was simply blank, and you didn’t know if something was still loading or if the savegame had an error.
If you already have a contract with a merchant on the world map, the merchant’s marker will no longer be displayed. Therefore, you will only see the merchants with whom you don’t have a contract.


Bugs

An upgrade to the theater/arena/odeon resulted in some food being lost per week: fixed.
The Spanish translation has some major problems, as incorrect texts lead to incorrect messages: fixed.
Some Spanish texts appear in the wrong position: fixed.
German text correction: fixed.
French text correction: fixed.
Production buildings show 0 production even though they are functioning: fixed.
Missing regional marble quarry in beginner map added.
The stone arena provides no entertainment points: fixed.
Blue T-pose guy – missing animation added.
Game saves weren’t saved correctly when leaving the city. The city was no longer there when loading. This issue is caused by two bugs. One is related to the actual saving process. This has been fixed. The other bug is still pending.
Wrong text when upgrading the iron production engine house: fixed.
Sometimes the mouse pointer does not respond when you click on the marker to build a bridge monument: fixed.
The Gladiator School could not be unlocked in some cases: fixed.
RAM consumption when starting a new city reduced by ~65%.
Certain carts had a malfunction in the path calculation, which resulted in the carts not appearing at the edge of the map or leading to crashes: fixed.
Dirt elements on city streets were always visible rather than appearing randomly: fixed.
Incorrect size display of backyard building A at Cives. Instead of 3×2, it was 4×2.
If you receive an emergency brick delivery in the easiest mode, the message appears every 5 seconds. Bug fixed. You no longer have to search for the bricks; they are added directly to your inventory.
If you built a necropolis on the edge of map 10, it could cause various game mechanics to no longer work.
If you applied for a rank and quit the game instead of going to collect the certificate, it was no longer possible to collect the certificate after a restart: fixed.
It was not possible to apply for the rank of consul: fixed.
Contracts concluded with a merchant on the world map were not saved under certain circumstances. The contracts were invalid upon loading: fixed.
If you bought food from a merchant on the world map, it didn’t arrive: fixed.
Setting a festival calendar would result in a lot of personal money being lost on a regular basis. This issue has been resolved.
It was not possible to demolish a Lupanar during the construction process: fixed.
If you want to demolish a building during construction, the new construction site elements (placeholders) do not disappear.
The white harbor building could be built without Vitruvius having already discovered the harbor.
In large cities, too many noise sources (e.g. from animals) have led to performance losses.


Story (and Story-Related Bugs)

If you go to Britain with the car and save in between, you can no longer continue playing the game.
In story mode, after visiting Rome, some players had a background image with a street and houses on the side that wouldn’t disappear. I couldn’t reproduce the bug. I found a solution to why the image wouldn’t disappear. It will be interesting to see if players continue to report this issue or if it has been resolved.

notes.title: Play Pax Augusta Demo
notes.content:
Salve and welcome to the demo of Pax Augusta
We are pleased to give you the opportunity to take a quick look at the game with the demo of Pax Augusta. Please note that the demo has a limited range of functions:

With the tutorial you can get an overview of all important functions

The playing time in career mode is limited to 60 minutes and one map

The Load & Save functions are deactivated

We hope that you like this little foretaste and that we will soon be able to welcome you to the loyal Pax Augusta community.
